Name: Intro_Medieval
Subtitle: Scene one, the Middle Ages! Knights, mud, honor. I want to smell the sweat in that armor!

Name: Intro_Space
Subtitle: Scene two, outer space! No gravity, no mercy. And no one can hear you scream, except me!

Name: Intro_Noir
Subtitle: Scene three, film noir! It's raining, the city's rotten, and you've got a revolver. Black and white, please!

Name: Intro_Finale
Subtitle: The grand finale! We mix everything! The producer's going to kill me, but who cares. ACTION!

Name: Action_01
Subtitle: Quiet on set... Rolling... ACTION!

Name: Action_02
Subtitle: And... ACTION!

Name: Action_03
Subtitle: We're rolling! Go, go, go!

Name: Action_04
Subtitle: Next take. Focus. ACTION!

Name: Action_05
Subtitle: Cameras are rolling, darling, ACTION!

Name: Cut_01
Subtitle: CUT! CUT! What was that?!

Name: Cut_02
Subtitle: CUT! No, no, no, I don't buy it for one second!

Name: Cut_03
Subtitle: CUT! You act like an extra in a yogurt commercial!

Name: Cut_04
Subtitle: CUT! Stop everything! I've got a brilliant idea!

Name: Cut_05
Subtitle: CUT! The audience is falling asleep, wake them up!

Name: Cut_06
Subtitle: CUT! My grandmother aims better than you, and she's blind!

Name: Cut_07
Subtitle: CUT! More emotion! More chaos! More EVERYTHING!

Name: Cut_08
Subtitle: CUT! Okay. Deep breath. And we change everything.

Name: Dir_Headshots
Subtitle: I want headshots! Nothing but headshots! It's artistic!

Name: Dir_KeepMoving
Subtitle: Keep moving! All the time! A star never stands still!

Name: Dir_MeleeOnly
Subtitle: Close combat! I want to see the whites of their eyes!

Name: Dir_NoDamage
Subtitle: Don't take a single hit, makeup spent three hours on your face!

Name: Dir_Fast
Subtitle: Faster! We only have the set until noon!

Name: Dir_LowHealth
Subtitle: I want suffering! Play it wounded, on the brink of death!

Name: Dir_NoReload
Subtitle: No reloading! Real heroes never reload!

Name: Dir_Stylish
Subtitle: Style! I want slides, jumps, a real show!

Name: Retake
Subtitle: Again! From the top! Nobody move!

Name: Retake_02
Subtitle: You're dead? You're DEAD?! That wasn't in the script!

Name: Retake_03
Subtitle: Okay. Next take. And this time you survive, got it?

Name: Retake_04
Subtitle: Makeup! More fake blood on him, we go again!

Name: Retake_05
Subtitle: Gorgeous death. Completely off-script. Again.

Name: Good_01
Subtitle: Yes! YES! That's cinema!

Name: Good_02
Subtitle: I'm crying. Crying with joy.

Name: Good_03
Subtitle: Now that's an Oscar! Keep that take!

Name: Good_04
Subtitle: The audience loves it! Keep going!

Name: Good_05
Subtitle: See, you can do it! Magnificent!

Name: Switch_01
Subtitle: Scene change! Quick, quick, quick!

Name: Switch_02
Subtitle: Moving on! Stagehands, get moving!

Name: Switch_03
Subtitle: New set, same hero, ACTION!

Name: Wrap
Subtitle: And... that's a wrap! Thank you all, pack it up!

Name: Wrap_Bad
Subtitle: That's a wrap... Well. We'll fix it in post.

Name: Dir_NoShield
Subtitle: No shield! A hero isn't afraid of a few hits!

Name: Dir_NoBow
Subtitle: Put that bow away! I want close combat, the real thing!

Name: Dir_LaserCost
Subtitle: That laser is expensive! Every shot comes out of MY budget!

Name: Staging_Improve
Subtitle: Let's improve the staging! Bring out the real sets!

Name: CastingIntro
Subtitle: Him? Fine... we'll make do. Slide down the ramp, then take out those three targets.

Name: CastingDone
Subtitle: Not bad. You're hired! Places, everyone, we're rolling!

Name: EventSpace
Subtitle: Heads up, gravity comes back on in three seconds!

Name: Event_Medieval
Subtitle: Release the horses! Here comes the convoy!

Name: Event_Noir
Subtitle: Kill the lights! Plunge it all into darkness!
